verdict.rationale: Apple documents concrete external connectivity specs — Thunderbolt 5 at up to 120Gb/s, external display support (dual 6K@60Hz or 6K+4K@144Hz), and unified memory bandwidth (273GB/s) — giving a developer some real numbers to plan a dock/build around. However, there's no documented PCIe generation/lane count for the SoC or discrete storage throughput/SSD speed specs, which are core to the story's 'PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage' ask. Missing for 10: explicit PCIe generation/lane specs, internal SSD/storage read-write throughput figures, independent benchmarking of real-world Thunderbolt 5 dock throughput.
